yogaFacts.title: Ancient Wisdom
yogaFacts.fact: Yoga is over 5,000 years old.
yogaFacts.details: Originating in the Indus–Saraswati civilization, yoga evolved as a complete system for physical health, mental discipline, and spiritual awakening. Its timeless principles continue to support modern lifestyles.

yogaFacts.title: Breath is Power
yogaFacts.fact: Pranayama boosts oxygen flow and calms your mind.
yogaFacts.details: Slow, deep breathing activates the parasympathetic nervous system, lowers stress hormones, and increases lung efficiency — making your mind clearer and your body more energized.

yogaFacts.title: Better Sleep
yogaFacts.fact: 10 minutes of yoga can improve your sleep sharply.
yogaFacts.details: Gentle stretches, controlled breathing, and mindful relaxation before bed reduce tension and prepare the body for restful, uninterrupted sleep by balancing the nervous system.

yogaFacts.title: Boosts Flexibility
yogaFacts.fact: Yoga increases flexibility and reduces stiffness.
yogaFacts.details: Consistent practice elongates muscles, lubricates joints, and loosens connective tissues — making daily movements smoother and reducing risk of injury.

yogaFacts.title: Strength + Stability
yogaFacts.fact: Yoga strengthens deep muscles and improves posture.
yogaFacts.details: Poses like Plank, Warrior, and Chair engage stabilizer muscles that are often neglected, creating balanced strength and a naturally upright posture.

yogaFacts.title: Natural Stress Relief
yogaFacts.fact: Yoga reduces cortisol — the stress hormone.
yogaFacts.details: Mindful breathing, meditation, and grounding poses bring the body out of 'fight or flight' mode, reducing anxiety, tension, and emotional exhaustion.

yogaFacts.title: Mind–Body Harmony
yogaFacts.fact: Yoga brings focus, awareness, and emotional balance.
yogaFacts.details: It trains the mind to notice thoughts without reacting, helping you stay calm, present, and emotionally centered throughout your day.

yogaFacts.title: Heart Health
yogaFacts.fact: Yoga improves cardiovascular health naturally.
yogaFacts.details: Regular practice helps regulate blood pressure, lowers LDL cholesterol, and enhances circulation — supporting long-term heart wellness.

yogaFacts.title: Boosts Immunity
